testsuite.name: com.chimali.fido2.data.transport.BluetoothHidTransportLifecycleTest

testcase.name: unallocated CIDs and stale session results are rejected before wallet ownership()
real wrapper connection callback rebases sender and fences reconnect traffic()
CID allocation has a session limit and a finite collision retry count()
prior sender cleanup cannot consume a successor generation response()
